scope: Stored reference entries whose written constitution did not match the compound the name denotes, found while proving derivation templates against the library rather than by fetching a source record. Each correction was derived from the compound's IUPAC name and cross-checked against the molecular formula computed by RDKit from the corrected structure. No source record was fetched for any of them, so the evidence here is structural reasoning, not a database response; the PubChem-sourced replacements are recorded separately in reference-identity-corrections.json.
method: Four of the first six were found while proving a penam template against the library: the template regenerated the other stored penicillins exactly and disagreed with these. The isoxazolyl penicillins are the case the formula cross-check cannot catch on its own, because the reversed substitution pattern is an isomer. Valacyclovir was found the same way, by a nucleoside template proven against 17 stored anchors including Acyclovir, whose stored structure does carry the oxymethyl bridge that the stored Valacyclovir had dropped. Articaine was found the same way: an aminoamide template proven against five stored local anesthetics could not reproduce it, and the stored entry proved to be missing the thiophene 4-methyl group and to have the C2 ester and C3 amide interchanged.

changes.name: Oxacillin
changes.reason: the isoxazole was written 4-methyl-5-phenyl-3-carboxamide; oxacillin is the 5-methyl-3-phenylisoxazole-4-carboxamide, an isomer the formula check cannot separate

changes.name: Cloxacillin
changes.reason: same reversed isoxazole substitution pattern as the stored oxacillin

changes.name: Flucloxacillin
changes.reason: the 2-chloro substituent of the 2-chloro-6-fluorophenyl ring was missing, and the isoxazole substitution pattern was reversed

changes.name: Piperacillin
changes.reason: the 4-ethyl-2,3-dioxopiperazine-1-carboxamide was written as a three-nitrogen, three-carbonyl, two-ethyl six-membered ring

changes.name: Meropenem
changes.reason: the dimethylcarbamoyl group was placed on the pyrrolidine nitrogen with a spurious second carboxylic acid on a ring carbon; it belongs on the C5 ring carbon with the nitrogen left as NH

changes.name: Imipenem
changes.reason: the 6-(1-hydroxyethyl) side chain was written as a bare methyl

changes.name: Valacyclovir
changes.reason: the 9-(2-hydroxyethoxymethyl) side chain was written as a 9-(2-hydroxyethyl) chain, dropping the oxymethyl bridge; valacyclovir is the L-valyl ester of acyclovir, whose own stored entry carries that bridge

changes.name: Articaine
changes.reason: articaine is methyl 4-methyl-3-(2-propylaminopropanamido)thiophene-2-carboxylate; the stored entry omitted the 4-methyl group entirely and placed the ester on C3 and the amide on C2, the reverse of the real substitution pattern
